meta.title: Viewing Spots — Whizzzest
meta.description: Wanzai Ancient City and Longhu Park — the best spots and transport tips for watching fireworks. Every Saturday at 8 pm, the Kiss of Flames lights up the sky.

hero.title: Fireworks viewing spots
hero.subtitle: The best places to watch the fireworks

spots.name: Wanzai Ancient City
spots.desc: Wanzai Ancient City is one of the best places to watch the fireworks: every Saturday at 8:00 pm the free "Kiss of Flames" show lights up the sky for 30 minutes. Stone-paved lanes, horse-head gables and brilliant fireworks mirror one another in a picture-perfect scene.
spots.viewing: Lüyin Square, the riverside promenade and the ancient city viewing terrace
spots.transport: In the heart of Wanzai's county seat — reachable by bus or taxi

spots.name: Longhu Park
spots.desc: Longhu Park is Wanzai's urban park, with a broad lake and open sightlines — an ideal fireworks vantage point. The bursts reflected in the water make for a double visual treat.
spots.viewing: The lakeside boardwalk, the mid-lake pavilion and the lakeside lawns
spots.transport: In the southwest of the county seat — reachable by bus or taxi

tips.title: Best times to watch
items: Every Saturday, 8:00–8:30 pm (Wanzai Ancient City fireworks show)
Major holidays (Spring Festival, Lantern Festival, National Day) and the Wanzai Fireworks Festival
Summer evenings — cooler air, perfect for the outdoors
Spring and autumn — mild weather and lovely scenery
Snowy winter nights — fireworks dancing with falling snow

tips.title: Good to know
items: Arrive early to claim a good vantage point
Stay safe: keep clear of launch sites and choose open ground
Protect the environment — take your litter with you
Bring a camera or phone to capture the moment

faq.q: When is the Kiss of Flames fireworks show?
faq.a: Every Saturday, 8:00–8:30 pm at Wanzai Ancient City, free of charge; extra shows run during major holidays and the Wanzai Fireworks Festival.

faq.q: Where are the best places to watch?
faq.a: Wanzai Ancient City (Lüyin Square, the riverside promenade and the ancient city viewing terrace) and Longhu Park (the lakeside boardwalk, the mid-lake pavilion and the lakeside lawns).
No — the Kiss of Flames is a free show. Arrive early for a good spot, keep clear of the launch sites and stay safe.

faq.q: How do I get to the Ancient City and Longhu Park?
faq.a: Both are inside Wanzai's county seat, reachable by bus or taxi — the Ancient City in the heart of town, Longhu Park in the southwest.

event.name: Kiss of Flames fireworks show
event.description: A free 30-minute fireworks show at Wanzai Ancient City every Saturday at 8:00 pm.
